During the [AI-Assisted Breach of Mexico's Government Infrastructure](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0064), the adversary tasked Claude Code to identify system information using `hostname`.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Breach) 
 

During the [AI-Assisted Breach of Mexico's Government Infrastructure](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0064), the adversary tasked Claude Code with using [CrackMapExec](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0488) to discover configuration information about the domain controllers.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Breach)
